description: Big aggressive market orders ("bursts": trades of the same side grouped in 5-second windows) of the last N minutes, with side (buy/sell), size, USD value, price and verdict (absorbed = the resting book took it and price did not go through; broke_through = it moved price), plus the share of absorbed bursts.

limit.description: Maximum number of bursts to return (1 to 200), largest first

min_usd.description: Only bursts worth at least this many USD

pair.description: Coin traded against USDT: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE, ZEC or NEAR

name: big_trades
title: Big trades (bursts)
